badge.description: Recognizes the named activity after instructor review at the confirmed threshold.

criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M8A9 (Builds with Flutter and AI).

Award threshold: 75%.

m8a9: Builds with Flutter and AI. Documented how AI was used while building a Flutter and Dart app. The assessment reviewed commit-linked usage entries, corrections to AI output, explanations of personal contributions and AI credit in the README.
